rulings.a: not as written: at a 30 s cadence two adjacent rows are about 30 s apart, so a strict first-to-last span over 30 s needs 3 rows nominally and flips on 1 s of jitter; primary = at least 2 adjacent on-rows (sample-hold duration = rows x step over 30 s); the strict timestamp span over 30 s is a sensitivity
rulings.b: 3 h gap accepted as an assumed soak time with 2 h, 6 h and calendar sensitivities; computed over the FULL master, never within the sample (this resolves the -0.114 / -0.373 issue); M769-M771 stay unchanged and are disclosed as using the calendar flag
rulings.c: exclude the isolated-row drives from the primary contrast; they enter only through the nested M771-definition counts; no third contrast
rulings.d: retest design right; the nested control is MANDATORY and a hard gate: from the streams reproduce the M771 gate exactly (241 drives on 102 days eligible, 8 on 7 days wet at 0.05, 2 on 2 days on the fuel basis, 212 dry) and the dark-proxy difference -0.114 (whole master) and -0.373 (within sample); any mismatch stops and writes nothing
rulings.e: the premise is false: the span rule drops the 0.05 threshold, so a long drive with 2 on-rows out of 40 or more is wet; the bound is the any-activity set (49 drives), not 8; keep A1' pre-registered; the gate is outcome-blind and no fuel outcome is read below the floor; apply the design-MDE check

required_changes: step rule: adjacent = step at most 35 s (as the M729 rear-fog rule); a hole over 35 s splits the run; 90 s is a sensitivity; update the known-answer tests (two rows 30 s apart = episode; a 36 s step = split)
a missing code inside a run splits it; the floor and the dry reference count only moving rows with a non-missing code; drives with all codes missing are excluded
moving window: the speed source is the cloud displayed speed; state whether a stop (below 10 km/h) inside a run splits it (recommend: split) and test it
state as a second definition change that the 0.05 threshold is dropped
A3' primary keeps the M771 wet-exclusion set so only the flag varies; the span-rule exclusion is a sensitivity; 3 h is primary; nothing is picked
the first drive of the master: flag 'unknown' and exclude it from the soak contrast (do not call it cold)
C: gaps as binned aggregates only
language: 'long-soak start (3 h or more after the previous logged drive; assumed cooling time)', never 'cold start' (it clashes with the Cold thermal class)
wiper episode = a precipitation, spray or washing proxy; codes 6 and 7 unnamed
M771 is not 'corrected': M772 is a retest under the span rule
fuel logged / app-calculated; association only; 'not supported' is not 'no weather effect'
coast-down: closed by the owner's decision (B-mode regenerates at every slow-down)
risks: unlogged driving shortens real gaps, so the 3 h flag over-labels long-soak starts
cloud-to-drive clock alignment is unvalidated (M729: offset later); the nested control covers it only partly
month fixed effects almost collinear with the wet proxy (0.96)
several flag variants invite picking the definition after seeing results
